about.label: About
about.title: Solid engineering, full focus on AI.

blocks.text: I came to AI through engineering. I started in 2017 with ERP, built integrations at Cogna — among the first in Brazil to implement the official WhatsApp service — and by early 2023 I was already shipping Generative AI in a product, followed by one of the first AI agent builder systems on the market.

At Cogna's AI Pro Hub I led 3 AI teams, each with its own Tech Lead, shipping sales agents, AI for paid media and dynamic pricing. Today, as Head of Artificial Intelligence at KHAL, I lead all of the company's AI delivery — more than 8 projects: I choose where AI creates value, architect the solutions and build the team that delivers them.

lab.label: Own lab
lab.title: Krun One — a decision model for agents
lab.role: Solo project · data, training, evaluation and release
lab.text: An 879-million-parameter encoder model that takes a context and a typed question and returns a calibrated decision in a single forward pass, with no text generation: intent, tool routing, true or false, scores and multiple choice. It can also abstain when it is unsure. It works in Portuguese, English, Spanish and French.
lab.multiText: Adds images, documents (including scans) and audio to the frozen text model, training only about 27 million fusion parameters (adapters and LoRA).
lab.note: Figures from KrunBench v1, my own validation set. On an external benchmark (JevBench public items) the result is 53.2%; limitations are documented in the model card. Apache-2.0 weights; research project.
